items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...It says, "He" -- Horface -- "is acknowledged to have been a more swinging piano soloist in the Earl Hines manner than was Fletcher."

ctx.x: That it was the first thing I saw in that book, and I became really a little upset about it. We're going to really check -- my attorney's going to check into quite a few of these things.

Might be worth it. This -- again I'm using a Xerox copy, but I believe this is probably from Leonard Feather's Encyclopedia that I'm quoting now. This is concerning you. It says, "He" -- Horface -- "is acknowledged to have been a more swinging piano soloist in the Earl Hines manner than was Fletcher." You want to make any comment on that? That's putting you on the spot.
